soc-analyst--quiz-alert-triage.question: An older threat report lists Defense Evasion for a behavior that your Falcon con
soc-analyst--quiz-alert-triage.quote: ATT&CK v19 renamed the old Defense Evasion tactic to Stealth and moved tool and log tampering into a new Defense Impairment tactic

soc-analyst--quiz-alert-triage.question: An analyst clicks Network Contain on a laptop that happens to be offline, and th
soc-analyst--quiz-alert-triage.quote: an isolation command can be issued while the endpoint is offline and only apply once it reconnects

soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.question: An email gateway line reads 09-28 12:14:02 (device in UTC+3) for the delivery of
soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.quote: The email gateway's timestamp is in local UTC+3 time; converting 09-28 12:14:02 local to UTC gives 2026-09-28T09:14:02Z.

soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.question: An analyst sees an on-premises event at 09:41 UTC, then pivots to the Microsoft
soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.quote: cloud audit logs can have their own ingestion delay (the event may not appear in the log for several minutes after it actually happened), which matters when deciding how wide a time window to search

soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.question: A report's fact table says: dropper.exe was present on WKS-4471 from 14 to 21 Se
soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.quote: Conflating inference with confirmed fact is one of the more serious credibility risks in an investigation report

soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.question: The analyst suspects that rjones' stolen credential was also used against cloud
soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.quote: table records Azure AD / Entra ID sign-in activity, including the account name, source IP, location, and application accessed

soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.question: Pivoting on 203.0.113.45, the analyst finds that WHOIS shows a fresh VPS registe
soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.quote: An IP pivot on a narrow, dedicated attacker IP (a fresh VPS, Virtual Private Server, registered days before the attack, hosting only the malicious domain) will produce a small, high-confidence set of related hosts.

soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.question: Two other hosts hold copies of the dropper. On host B it was renamed but is othe
soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.quote: Any change to the file, even a single byte, produces a completely different hash, which makes a hash match a very high-confidence indicator that two files are byte-for-byte identical (unlike a filename, which is trivial for an attacker to rename)

soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.question: An analyst closes an alert as Benign Positive with the note: expected activity.
soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.quote: Extensive for True Positive (IOCs, technique IDs, affected hosts/accounts), root-cause-focused for False Positive, scope-and-authorization-focused for Benign Positive

soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.question: Two hours into scoping, each new pivot still turns up previously unseen hosts, a
soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.quote: It means escalating with the best current understanding of scope, clearly labeled as provisional, and continuing deeper investigation in parallel with the response actions

soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.question: A rule that flags unusual outbound scanning traffic fires on scans from a range
soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.quote: a rule flagging unusual outbound scanning traffic correctly fires during an authorized, scheduled penetration test

soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.question: After a host pivot confirms malware on WKS-2210, the analyst closes the ticket a
soc-analyst--quiz-investigation-workflow.quote: risks closing the ticket while the true extent of the incident is still unknown

soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.question: During an intrusion, the attacker stops the EDR sensor and halts log forwarding
soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.quote: TA0112 | Defense Impairment | Disable or degrade security tools, logging, and other defenses

soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.question: Last month an LSASS memory dump was done with Mimikatz, and this month the same
soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.quote: Do not create a new mapping every time a different tool is involved in the same underlying behavior.

soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.question: An intrusion shows Discovery, then Lateral Movement, then Discovery again on the
soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.quote: ATT&CK explicitly does not require attackers to move through tactics in strict order, and it is common for an intrusion to revisit an earlier tactic multiple times

soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.question: An EDR alert shows rundll32.exe opening lsass.exe with GrantedAccess 0x1FFFFF. N
soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.quote: This is the classic fingerprint of a credential-dumping tool reading LSASS's memory to extract stored credentials

soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.question: An analyst's escalation note says only: Technique T1003.001. The receiving Tier
soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.quote: a clear one-line summary per technique, the tactic, and the specific evidence that supports the mapping, not just the ID by itself

soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.question: A threat report says observed activity is consistent with G0016, and the SOC wan
soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.quote: (for example, G0016 for APT29), documenting a named threat actor and every technique ATT&CK has evidence they have used

soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.question: NexaCorp's coverage table shows T1059.001 PowerShell as Partial: Sysmon Event ID
soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.quote: Separating visibility from detection distinguishes 'we can't see this' (a logging problem) from 'we see it but have no rule' (a detection-engineering problem).

soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.question: While working an intrusion, an analyst could not read what an encoded PowerShell
soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.quote: Name the exact log source or field that was missing, or the exact rule logic that would have flagged the behavior sooner.

soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.question: Two open gaps compete for this quarter. Gap A is a rare but catastrophic techniq
soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.quote: A rare but catastrophic technique with zero visibility might reasonably outrank a common but low-impact technique that already has partial detection.

soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.question: In a DeTT&CT review, the team scores a data source low because field names diffe
soc-analyst--quiz-mitre-attack.quote: a technique that relies on a data source with poor quality (say, inconsistent field names across different log forwarders) inherits a correspondingly weaker visibility score, even before anyone asks whether a detection rule exists

threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.question: An advisory lists four things about an intrusion: a malware file hash, a command
threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.quote: from trivial for an attacker to change (bottom) to painful for an attacker to change (top): hash values, IP addresses, domain names, network/host artifacts, tools, and finally TTPs at the very top

threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.question: A hunter runs a Kerberoasting query (Event ID 4769) over 30 days and gets zero r
threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.quote: A hunt result should be logged as 'inconclusive: visibility gap' rather than 'clean negative' when the data source isn't confirmed flowing.

threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.question: A hunter writes: If an attacker is using scheduled tasks for persistence (T1053.
threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.quote: Name the exact table or telemetry feed for the data source, not just 'the SIEM.'

threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.question: A junior hunter plans a single query to hunt for lateral movement across the who
threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.quote: Time-box every hunt's scope to avoid an unmanageable 'boil the ocean' query.

threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.question: A UEBA platform assigns a user a high risk score and a hunter wants to start fro
threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.quote: A hunt that begins with a UEBA risk score still must be narrowed into a specific, testable statement before a hunter starts querying

threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.question: A SOC runs its hunts from a written, repeatable procedure that any hunter can fo
threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.quote: HM2 organizations run hunts using a documented, repeatable procedure, roughly where the methodology from this lesson operates.

threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.question: A Sigma rule runs on fully collected Kerberos ticket data, but it fires hundreds
threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.quote: is it actually tuned well enough to be trusted, or does it generate so many false positives that analysts have started ignoring it

threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.question: Two gaps are on the backlog. Gap 1: Kerberos ticket auditing is off on the domai
threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.quote: A cheap fix on a relevant, critical gap is an obvious first move; an expensive fix on a low-relevance, low-criticality gap can reasonably wait.

threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.question: In an ATT&CK Navigator layer, most of the Lateral Movement column is yellow. Usi
threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.quote: Common convention: red/dark = no visibility, yellow = visibility without detection, green = both visibility and detection confirmed.

threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.question: An advisory says an intrusion set used a phishing attachment, then a Registry Ru
threat-hunter--quiz-hunt-methodology.quote: Each of those three IDs becomes its own mini-hunt with its own hypothesis.

threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.question: A hunter joins high-risk sign-ins (left) to DeviceProcessEvents (right) with kin
threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.quote: using inner instead would silently drop every risky sign-in that had no endpoint match at all, hiding exactly the cases a hunter most needs to see and decide on

threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.question: A hunter must tag 2 million high-risk sign-in events with whether IPAddress appe
threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.quote: lookup signals to anyone reading the query that the right-hand table is expected to be small and mostly static

threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.question: A hunter has a blob storage URL that includes a SAS token and wants to read the
threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.quote: Prefix a storage URL containing a SAS token with h@ so Kusto redacts it from query history and logs.

threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.question: A hunter wants failed logon counts per account but writes summarize count() with
threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.quote: omitting the by clause entirely does not produce an error; it silently collapses the entire table into a single row

threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.question: Two accounts both show count() = 30 failed logons over 30 days when grouped by a
threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.quote: an account with 30 failed logons evenly spread across a normal month looks nothing like 30 failed logons in a single hour, even though a plain count() by Account alone would report the same total for both

threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.question: Which expression returns, for each TargetUserName, the most recent logon event t
threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.quote: returns exactly one row per account, its single most recent logon, with every other column (the device, the source IP, the logon type) intact from that specific, most-recent event

threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.question: A hunter builds a per-user baseline over the last 30 days up to now. One user ha
threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.quote: Leave a gap between the baseline window and 'now' so recent, possibly-anomalous activity can't poison its own baseline.

threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.question: Account A normally sends about 10 MB a day and account B about 400 MB. A rule fl
threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.quote: a fixed number treats every account identically regardless of whether it normally sends 10 megabytes a day or 400

threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.question: A host always spikes in process creation at 9 AM on workdays. After running seri
threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.quote: The residual component should look like structureless noise; real anomalies stand out there once seasonality is removed.

threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.question: A team computed a decomposition model once on January data and never refreshed i
threat-hunter--quiz-query-languages.quote: A sliding window recomputes make-series on a moving lookback period, refreshed on a schedule.

threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.question: A team wants to validate its detections against a chain of attacker actions that
threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.quote: MITRE CALDERA automates multi-step, multi-host adversary emulation operations, not single isolated techniques.

threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.question: A Sigma selection requires Image ending in powershell.exe, plus a CommandLine co
threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.quote: A selection map combines multiple fields with AND, and multiple values under one field with OR.

threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.question: A rule uses CommandLine|base64offset|contains with the value IEX to catch PowerS
threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.quote: wide|base64offset|contains matches a value hidden inside a PowerShell -EncodedCommand payload: wide converts it to UTF-16LE first, because that is how PowerShell encodes the script before base64.

threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.question: Why does the module's example rule stay at category: process_creation and produc
threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.quote: The same logsource can be converted against multiple underlying data sources (e.g., Sysmon vs. native Windows auditing).

threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.question: An analyst converts the module's rule with the sysmon pipeline and deploys it, b
threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.quote: A pipeline/data-source mismatch can leave fields silently unmapped, producing a query that runs but never matches anything.

threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.question: A colleague reviews converted SPL and sees SQBFAFgA, kARQBYA, and JAEUAWA in the
threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.quote: If a converted query ever shows the plain words in this clause, the modifier was lost somewhere and the search can never match an encoded command.

threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.question: A hunter wants one Elastic query for this behavior: a process spawns a second pr
threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.quote: eql is the better choice once a detection needs to express a sequence of related events rather than one event's fields.

threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.question: Both fixtures use -EncodedCommand. The positive fixture fires the converted rule
threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.quote: Negative fixtures specifically prove a rule isn't over-broad, not just that it can fire at all.

threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.question: A CI pipeline runs sigma check, then sigma convert for each target, then deploys
threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.quote: A CI pipeline that stops at conversion without fixture testing has not proven the rule actually works.

threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.question: A rule correctly detects encoded PowerShell, but its tags list only attack.execu
threat-hunter--quiz-sigma-and-detection.quote: Coverage tooling and ATT&CK Navigator heatmaps rely on technique tags to compute per-technique detection coverage.
